shellCommands.command: ls -la; cat package.json 2>/dev/null; git status --short | head -20; find . -path ./node_modules -prune -o -path ./.git -prune -o -type f -print | head -50
cat app/layout.tsx app/page.tsx next.config.ts tsconfig.json; ls node_modules/next/dist/docs 2>/dev/null | head
cd node_modules/next/dist/docs; f=$(grep -rl "^title: cookies" . | head -1); echo $f; sed -n 1,60p $f

npx next build 2>&1 | tail -20 && (npx next start -p 3456 >/tmp/s.log 2>&1 &) ; sleep 4; curl -s localhost:3456 | grep -o 'Current theme.*' | head -2; curl -s -H 'Cookie: theme=dark' -H 'Accept-Language: fr-CA;q=0.7,de;q=0.9' localhost:3456 | grep -o 'Current theme.*language: [^<]*'; pkill -f "next start"
